ayahs.ar: صٓ وَالۡقُرۡاٰنِ ذِي الذِّكۡرِؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Saaad; wal-Qur-aani ziz zikr
ayahs.en: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder...

ayahs.ar: بَلِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا فِيۡ عِزَّةٍ وَّشِقَاقٍ
ayahs.tl: Balil lazeena kafaroo fee 'izzatilnw wa shiqaaq
ayahs.en: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.

ayahs.ar: كَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡنٍ فَنَادَوۡا وَّلَاتَ حِيۡنَ مَنَاصٍ
ayahs.tl: Kam ahlaknaa min qablihim min qarnin fanaadaw wa laata heena manaas
ayahs.en: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.

ayahs.ar: وَعَجِبُوۡ٘ا اَنۡ جَآءَهُمۡ مُّنۡذِرٌ مِّنۡهُمۡؗ وَقَالَ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ هٰذَا سٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa 'ajibooo an jaaa'a hum munzirum minhum wa qaalal kaafiroona haazaa saahirun kazzaab
ayahs.en: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.

ayahs.ar: اَجَعَلَ الۡاٰلِهَةَ اِلٰهًا وَّاحِدًاۚۖ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عُجَابٌ
ayahs.tl: Aja'alal aalihata Ilaahanw Waahidan inna haazaa lashai'un 'ujaab
ayahs.en: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."

ayahs.ar: وَانۡطَلَقَ الۡمَلَاُ مِنۡهُمۡ اَنِ امۡشُوۡا وَاصۡبِرُوۡا عَلٰ٘ي اٰلِهَتِكُمۡۚۖ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ يُّرَادُۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wantalaqal mala-u minhum anim shoo wasbiroo 'alaaa aalihatikum innna haazaa lashai 'uny yuraad
ayahs.en: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.

ayahs.ar: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهٰذَا فِي الۡمِلَّةِ الۡاٰخِرَةِۚۖ اِنۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا اخۡتِلَاقٌۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Maa sami'naa bihaazaa fil millatil aakhirati in haazaaa illakh tilaaq
ayahs.en: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.

ayahs.ar: ءَاُنۡزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ الذِّكۡرُ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِنَاؕ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّنۡ ذِكۡرِيۡۚ بَلۡ لَّمَّا يَذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابِؕ‏
ayahs.tl: 'A-unzila 'alaihiz zikru mim baininaa; bal hum fee shakkim min Zikree bal lammaa yazooqoo 'azaab
ayahs.en: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ عِنۡدَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡوَهَّابِۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Am'indahum khazaaa 'inu rahmati Rabbikal 'Azeezil Wahhab
ayahs.en: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ لَهُمۡ مُّلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاࣞ فَلۡيَرۡتَقُوۡا فِي الۡاَسۡبَابِ
ayahs.tl: Am lahum mulkus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa falyartaqoo fil asbaab
ayahs.en: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.

ayahs.ar: جُنۡدٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُوۡمٌ مِّنَ الۡاَحۡزَابِ
ayahs.tl: Jundum maa hunaalika mahzoomum minal Ahzaab
ayahs.en: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوۡحٍ وَّعَادٌ وَّفِرۡعَوۡنُ ذُو الۡاَوۡتَادِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Lootinw-wa 'Aadunw wa Fir'awnu zul awtaad
ayahs.en: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,

ayahs.ar: وَثَمُوۡدُ وَقَوۡمُ لُوۡطٍ وَّاَصۡحٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ الۡاَحۡزَابُ
ayahs.tl: Wa Samoodu wa qawmu Lootinw wa Ashaabul 'Aykah; ulaaa'ikal Ahzaab
ayahs.en: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies.

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ كُلٌّ اِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: In kullun illaa kazzabar Rusula fahaqqa 'iqaab
ayahs.en: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَنۡظُرُ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِنۡ فَوَاقٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa yanzuru haaa ulaaa'i illaa saihatanw waahidatam maa lahaa min fawaaq
ayahs.en: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا عَجِّلۡ لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ الۡحِسَابِ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo Rabbanaa 'ajjil lanaa qittanaa qabla Yawmil Hisaab
ayahs.en: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account"

ayahs.ar: اِصۡبِرۡ عَلٰي مَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ وَاذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا دَاوٗدَ ذَا الۡاَيۡدِۚ اِنَّهٗ٘ اَوَّابٌ
ayahs.tl: Isbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wazkur 'abdanaa Daawooda zal aidi aidi innahooo awwaab
ayahs.en: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah].

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا الۡجِبَالَ مَعَهٗ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِالۡعَشِيِّ وَالۡاِشۡرَاقِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaa sakhkharnal jibaala ma'ahoo yusabbihna bil'ashaiyi wal ishraaq
ayahs.en: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.

ayahs.ar: وَالطَّيۡرَ مَحۡشُوۡرَةًؕ كُلٌّ لَّهٗ٘ اَوَّابٌ
ayahs.tl: Wattayra mahshoorah; kullul lahooo awwaab
ayahs.en: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].

ayahs.ar: وَشَدَدۡنَا مُلۡكَهٗ وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُ الۡحِكۡمَةَ وَفَصۡلَ الۡخِطَابِ
ayahs.tl: Wa shadadnaa mulkahoo wa aatainaahul Hikmata wa faslal khitaab
ayahs.en: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.

ayahs.ar: وَهَلۡ اَتٰىكَ نَبَؤُا الۡخَصۡمِۘ اِذۡ تَسَوَّرُوا الۡمِحۡرَابَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa hal ataaka naba'ul khasm; iz tasawwarul mihraab
ayahs.en: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ دَخَلُوۡا عَلٰي دَاوٗدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنۡهُمۡ قَالُوۡا لَا تَخَفۡۚ خَصۡمٰنِ بَغٰي بَعۡضُنَا عَلٰي بَعۡضٍ فَاحۡكُمۡ بَيۡنَنَا بِالۡحَقِّ وَلَا تُشۡطِطۡ وَاهۡدِنَا٘ اِلٰي سَوَآءِ الصِّرَاطِ
ayahs.tl: Iz dakhaloo 'alaa Daawooda fafazi'a minhum qaaloo la takhaf khasmaani baghaa ba'dunaa 'alaa ba'din fahkum bainanaaa bilhaqqi wa laa tushtit wahdinaaa ilaa Sawaaa'is Siraat
ayahs.en: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ هٰذَا٘ اَخِيۡࣞ لَهٗ تِسۡعٌ وَّتِسۡعُوۡنَ نَعۡجَةً وَّلِيَ نَعۡجَةٌ وَّاحِدَةٌࣞ فَقَالَ اَكۡفِلۡنِيۡهَا وَعَزَّنِيۡ فِي الۡخِطَابِ
ayahs.tl: Inna haazaaa akhee lahoo tis'unw wa tis'oona na'jatanw wa liya na'jatunw waahidah; faqaala akfilneeha wa 'azzanee filkhitaab
ayahs.en: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَقَدۡ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعۡجَتِكَ اِلٰي نِعَاجِهٖؕ وَاِنَّ كَثِيۡرًا مِّنَ الۡخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبۡغِيۡ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلٰي بَعۡضٍ اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَقَلِيۡلٌ مَّا هُمۡؕ وَظَنَّ دَاوٗدُ اَنَّمَا فَتَنّٰهُ فَاسۡتَغۡفَرَ رَبَّهٗ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَّاَنَابَࣛ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala laqad zalamaka bisu 'aali na'jatika ilaa ni'aajihee wa inna kaseeram minal khulataaa'i la-yabghee ba'duhum 'alaa ba'din illal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati wa qaleehum maa hum; wa zanna Daawoodu annamaa fatannaahu fastaghrara Rabbahoo wa kharra raaki'anw wa anaab
ayahs.en: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah].

ayahs.ar: فَغَفَرۡنَا لَهٗ ذٰلِكَؕ وَاِنَّ لَهٗ عِنۡدَنَا لَزُلۡفٰي وَحُسۡنَ مَاٰبٍ
ayahs.tl: Faghafarnaa lahoo zaalik; wa inna lahoo 'indanaa lazulfaa wa husna ma aab
ayahs.en: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

ayahs.ar: يٰدَاوٗدُ اِنَّا جَعَلۡنٰكَ خَلِيۡفَةً فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَاحۡكُمۡ بَيۡنَ النَّاسِ بِالۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الۡهَوٰي فَيُضِلَّكَ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يَضِلُّوۡنَ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ شَدِيۡدٌۭ بِمَا نَسُوۡا يَوۡمَ الۡحِسَابِࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaa Daawoodu innaa ja'alnaaka khaleefatan fil ardi fahkum bainan naasi bilhaqqi wa laa tattabi'il hawaa fayudillaka 'an sabeelil laah; innal lazeena yadilloona 'an sabeelil laah; lahum 'azaabun shadeedum bimaa nasoo Yawmal Hisaab
ayahs.en: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا السَّمَآءَ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا بَاطِلًاؕ ذٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡاۚ فَوَيۡلٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنَ النَّارِؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ma khalaqnas samaaa'a wal arda wa maa bainahumaa baatilaa; zaalika zannul lazeena kafaroo; fawi lul lillazeena kafaroo minan Naar
ayahs.en: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ كَالۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِؗ اَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ كَالۡفُجَّارِ
ayahs.tl: Am naj'alul lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati kalmufisdeena fil ardi am naj'alul muttaqeena kalfujjaar
ayahs.en: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked?

ayahs.ar: كِتٰبٌ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ اِلَيۡكَ مُبٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوۡ٘ا اٰيٰتِهٖ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ اُولُوا الۡاَلۡبَابِ
ayahs.tl: Kitaabun anzalnaahu ilaika mubaarakul liyaddabbarooo Aayaatihee wa liyatazakkara ulul albaab
ayahs.en: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.

ayahs.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لِدَاوٗدَ سُلَيۡمٰنَؕ نِعۡمَ الۡعَبۡدُؕ اِنَّهٗ٘ اَوَّابٌؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa wahabnaa li Daawooda Sulaimaan; ni'mal 'abd; innahoo awwaab
ayahs.en: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ عُرِضَ عَلَيۡهِ بِالۡعَشِيِّ الصّٰفِنٰتُ الۡجِيَادُۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Iz 'urida 'alaihi bil'ashiy yis saafinaatul jiyaad
ayahs.en: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.

ayahs.ar: فَقَالَ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَحۡبَبۡتُ حُبَّ الۡخَيۡرِ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِ رَبِّيۡۚ حَتّٰي تَوَارَتۡ بِالۡحِجَابِࣞ‏
ayahs.tl: Faqaala inneee ahbabtu hubbal khairi 'an zikri Rabbee hattaa tawaarat bilhijaab
ayahs.en: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."

ayahs.ar: رُدُّوۡهَا عَلَيَّؕ فَطَفِقَ مَسۡحًاۭ بِالسُّوۡقِ وَالۡاَعۡنَاقِ
ayahs.tl: Ruddoohaa 'alaiya fatafiqa masham bissooqi wal a'naaq
ayahs.en: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا سُلَيۡمٰنَ وَاَلۡقَيۡنَا عَلٰي كُرۡسِيِّهٖ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ اَنَابَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad fatannaa Sulaimaana wa alqainaa 'alaa kursiyyihee jasadan summa anaab
ayahs.en: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اغۡفِرۡ لِيۡ وَهَبۡ لِيۡ مُلۡكًا لَّا يَنۭۡ بَغِيۡ لِاَحَدٍ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِيۡۚ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ الۡوَهَّابُ
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbigh fir lee wa hab lee mulkal laa yambaghee li ahadim mim ba'de inaka Antal Wahhab
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."

ayahs.ar: فَسَخَّرۡنَا لَهُ الرِّيۡحَ تَجۡرِيۡ بِاَمۡرِهٖ رُخَآءً حَيۡثُ اَصَابَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fasakhkharnaa lahur reeha tajree bi amrihee rukhaaa'an haisu asaab
ayahs.en: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,

ayahs.ar: وَالشَّيٰطِيۡنَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَّغَوَّاصٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wash Shayaateena kulla bannaaa'inw wa ghawwaas
ayahs.en: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver

ayahs.ar: وَّاٰخَرِيۡنَ مُقَرَّنِيۡنَ فِي الۡاَصۡفَادِ
ayahs.tl: Wa aakhareena muqarraneena fil asfaad
ayahs.en: And others bound together in shackles.

ayahs.ar: هٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَامۡنُنۡ اَوۡ اَمۡسِكۡ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.tl: Haazaa 'ataaa'unaa famnun aw amsik bighairi hisaab
ayahs.en: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّ لَهٗ عِنۡدَنَا لَزُلۡفٰي وَحُسۡنَ مَاٰبٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa inna lahoo 'indanaa lazulfaa wa husna ma-aab
ayahs.en: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

ayahs.ar: وَاذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا٘ اَيُّوۡبَۘ اِذۡ نَادٰي رَبَّهٗ٘ اَنِّيۡ مَسَّنِيَ الشَّيۡطٰنُ بِنُصۡبٍ وَّعَذَابٍؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wazkur 'abdanaaa Ayyoob; iz naada Rabbahooo annee massaniyash Shaitaanu binus binw wa 'azaab
ayahs.en: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."

ayahs.ar: اُرۡكُضۡ بِرِجۡلِكَۚ هٰذَا مُغۡتَسَلٌۭ بَارِدٌ وَّشَرَابٌ
ayahs.tl: Urkud birijlika haaza mughtasalum baaridunw wa sharaab
ayahs.en: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink."

ayahs.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهٗ٘ اَهۡلَهٗ وَمِثۡلَهُمۡ مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكۡرٰي لِاُولِي الۡاَلۡبَابِ
ayahs.tl: Wa wahabnaa lahoo ahlahoo wa mislahum ma'ahum rahmatam minna wa zikraa li ulil albaab
ayahs.en: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.

ayahs.ar: وَخُذۡ بِيَدِكَ ضِغۡثًا فَاضۡرِبۡ بِّهٖ وَلَا تَحۡنَثۡؕ اِنَّا وَجَدۡنٰهُ صَابِرًاؕ نِعۡمَ الۡعَبۡدُؕ اِنَّهٗ٘ اَوَّابٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa khuz biyadika dighsan fadrib bihee wa laa tahnas, innaa wajadnaahu saabiraa; ni'mal 'abd; innahooo awwaab
ayahs.en: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].

ayahs.ar: وَاذۡكُرۡ عِبٰدَنَا٘ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ وَاِسۡحٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَ اُولِي الۡاَيۡدِيۡ وَالۡاَبۡصَارِ
ayahs.tl: Wazkur 'ibaadanaaa Ibraaheema wa Is-haaqa wa Ya'qooba ulil-aydee walabsaar
ayahs.en: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَخۡلَصۡنٰهُمۡ بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكۡرَي الدَّارِۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaaa akhlasnaahum bi khaalisatin zikrad daar
ayahs.en: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّهُمۡ عِنۡدَنَا لَمِنَ الۡمُصۡطَفَيۡنَ الۡاَخۡيَارِؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa innahum 'indanaa laminal mustafainal akhyaar
ayahs.en: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.

ayahs.ar: وَاذۡكُرۡ اِسۡمٰعِيۡلَ وَالۡيَسَعَ وَذَا الۡكِفۡلِؕ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ الۡاَخۡيَارِؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wazkur Ismaa'eela wal Yasa'a wa Zal-Kifli wa kullum minal akhyaar
ayahs.en: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.

ayahs.ar: هٰذَا ذِكۡرٌؕ وَاِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ لَحُسۡنَ مَاٰبٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Haazaa zikr; wa inna lilmuttaqeena lahusna ma aab
ayahs.en: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return

ayahs.ar: جَنّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ الۡاَبۡوَابُۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Jannaati 'adnim mufat tahatal lahumul abwaab
ayahs.en: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.

ayahs.ar: مُتَّكِـِٕيۡنَ فِيۡهَا يَدۡعُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيۡرَةٍ وَّشَرَابٍ
ayahs.tl: Muttaki'eena feehaa yad'oona feehaa bifaakihatin kaseeratinw wa sharaab
ayahs.en: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.

ayahs.ar: وَعِنۡدَهُمۡ قٰصِرٰتُ الطَّرۡفِ اَتۡرَابٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa 'indahum qaasiraatut tarfi atraab
ayahs.en: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.

ayahs.ar: هٰذَا مَا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ لِيَوۡمِ الۡحِسَابِࣚ‏
ayahs.tl: Haaza maa too'odoona li Yawmil Hisaab
ayahs.en: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ هٰذَا لَرِزۡقُنَا مَا لَهٗ مِنۡ نَّفَادٍۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Inna haazaa larizqunaa maa lahoo min nafaad
ayahs.en: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.

ayahs.ar: هٰذَاؕ وَاِنَّ لِلطّٰغِيۡنَ لَشَرَّ مَاٰبٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Haazaa; wa inna littaagheena lasharra ma-aab
ayahs.en: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -

ayahs.ar: جَهَنَّمَۚ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَاۚ فَبِئۡسَ الۡمِهَادُ
ayahs.tl: Jahannama yaslawnahaa fai'sal mihaad
ayahs.en: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.

ayahs.ar: هٰذَاۙ فَلۡيَذُوۡقُوۡهُ حَمِيۡمٌ وَّغَسَّاقٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Haazaa falyazooqoohu hameemunw wa ghassaaq
ayahs.en: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.

ayahs.ar: وَّاٰخَرُ مِنۡ شَكۡلِهٖ٘ اَزۡوَاجٌؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa aakharu min shak liheee azwaaj
ayahs.en: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.

ayahs.ar: هٰذَا فَوۡجٌ مُّقۡتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمۡۚ لَا مَرۡحَبًاۭ بِهِمۡؕ اِنَّهُمۡ صَالُوا النَّارِ
ayahs.tl: Haazaa fawjum muqtahimum ma'akum laa marhabam bihim; innahum saalun Naar
ayahs.en: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا بَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡࣞ لَا مَرۡحَبًاۭ بِكُمۡؕ اَنۡتُمۡ قَدَّمۡتُمُوۡهُ لَنَاۚ فَبِئۡسَ الۡقَرَارُ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo bal antum laa marhabam bikum; antum qaddamtumoohu lanaa fabi'sal qaraar
ayahs.en: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا مَنۡ قَدَّمَ لَنَا هٰذَا فَزِدۡهُ عَذَابًا ضِعۡفًا فِي النَّارِ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo Rabbanaa man qaddama lanaa haaza fazidhu 'azaaban di'fan fin Naar
ayahs.en: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا مَا لَنَا لَا نَرٰي رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَشۡرَارِؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo ma lanaa laa naraa rijaalan kunnaa na'udduhum minal ashraar
ayahs.en: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?

ayahs.ar: اَتَّخَذۡنٰهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا اَمۡ زَاغَتۡ عَنۡهُمُ الۡاَبۡصَارُ
ayahs.tl: Attakhaznaahum sikh riyyan am zaaghat 'anhumul absaar
ayahs.en: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ اَهۡلِ النَّارِࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Inna zaalika lahaqqun takhaasumu Ahlin Naar
ayahs.en: Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا٘ اَنَا مُنۡذِرٌࣗۖ وَّمَا مِنۡ اِلٰهٍ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ الۡوَاحِدُ الۡقَهَّارُۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul innamaaa ana munzirunw wa maa min ilaahim illal laahul Waahidul Qahhaar
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing.

ayahs.ar: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡغَفَّارُ
ayahs.tl: Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumal 'Azeezul Ghaffaar
ayahs.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا عَظِيۡمٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul huwa naba'un 'azeem
ayahs.en: Say, "It is great news

ayahs.ar: اَنۡتُمۡ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Antum 'anhu mu'ridoon
ayahs.en: From which you turn away.

ayahs.ar: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۭ بِالۡمَلَاِ الۡاَعۡلٰ٘ي اِذۡ يَخۡتَصِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Maa kaana liya min 'ilmim bilmala il a'laaa iz yakhtasimoon
ayahs.en: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ يُّوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيَّ اِلَّا٘ اَنَّمَا٘ اَنَا نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Iny-yoohaaa ilaiya illaaa annnamaaa ana nazeerum mubeen
ayahs.en: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اِنِّيۡ خَالِقٌۭ بَشَرًا مِّنۡ طِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala Rabbuka lilmalaaa'ikati innee khaaliqum basharam min teen
ayahs.en: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.

ayahs.ar: فَاِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهٗ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيۡهِ مِنۡ رُّوۡحِيۡ فَقَعُوۡا لَهٗ سٰجِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa-iza sawwaituhoo wa nafakhtu feehi mir roohee faqa'oo lahoo saajideen
ayahs.en: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."

ayahs.ar: فَسَجَدَ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fasajadal malaaa'ikatu kulluhum ajma'oon
ayahs.en: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely.

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا٘ اِبۡلِيۡسَؕ اِسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Illaaa Iblees; istakbara wa kaana minal kaafireen
ayahs.en: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰ٘اِبۡلِيۡسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ اَنۡ تَسۡجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقۡتُ بِيَدَيَّؕ اَسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ اَمۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الۡعَالِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala yaaa Ibleesu maa man'aka an tasjuda limaa khalaqtu biyadai; astakbarta am kunta min 'aaleen
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَنَا خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡهُؕ خَلَقۡتَنِيۡ مِنۡ نَّارٍ وَّخَلَقۡتَهٗ مِنۡ طِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Qaala ana khairum minah; khalaqtanee min naarinw wa khalaqtahoo min teen
ayahs.en: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَاخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَاِنَّكَ رَجِيۡمٌۖۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala fakhruj minhaa fainnaka rajeem
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled.

ayahs.ar: وَّاِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ لَعۡنَتِيۡ٘ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الدِّيۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Wa inna 'alaika la'nateee ilaa Yawmid Deen
ayahs.en: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنۡظِرۡنِيۡ٘ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbi fa anzirneee ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَاِنَّكَ مِنَ الۡمُنۡظَرِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala fa innaka minal munzareen
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

ayahs.ar: اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الۡوَقۡتِ الۡمَعۡلُوۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Ilaa Yawmil waqtil ma'loom
ayahs.en: Until the Day of the time well-known."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَاُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala fabi'izzatika la ughwiyannahum ajma'een
ayahs.en: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ الۡمُخۡلَصِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Illaa 'ibaadaka minhumul mukhlaseen
ayahs.en: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَالۡحَقُّؗ وَالۡحَقَّ اَقُوۡلُۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala falhaqq, walhaqqa aqool
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -

ayahs.ar: لَاَمۡلَـَٔنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنۡكَ وَمِمَّنۡ تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: La amla'annna Jahannama minka wa mimman tabi'aka minhum ajma'een
ayahs.en: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ مَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍ وَّمَا٘ اَنَا مِنَ الۡمُتَكَلِّفِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrinw wa maaa ana minal mutakallifeen
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكۡرٌ لِّلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: In huwa illaa zikrul lil'aalameen
ayahs.en: It is but a reminder to the worlds.

ayahs.ar: وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ نَبَاَهٗ بَعۡدَ حِيۡنٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa lata'lamunna naba ahoo ba'da heen
ayahs.en: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
